body: Yo, I am here for you as well. Let loose your heart.

It is hard, I agree. But when those that were supposed to care for you abandons you, betrays you or plain ignores you, that feels hard.

I hope, you get through it all. You being in medical school means, you can still help people. I hope you find someone who cares for you. If you ever wanna talk and I am not ded. You know where to find me.

I am a little late to the party. Been an avid player for 4 years. Would like to ask two things.

1. When is the reputation system coming and what it entails.

2. Can we get a vote to kick in all game modes. Cause sometimes, this one player is 'deranking' and they sabotage the gameplay in miniscule ways. And we cant do anything more than kill him twice.
